movie.title: Children of Blood and Bone
movie.overview: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a kingdom where magic has been violently suppressed, a young woman named Zélie teams up with her brother and defecting royals to restore power to her oppressed people and overthrow a tyrant king.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After the brutal King Saran orders the slaughter of all maji and strips Orïsha of its magic, Zélie Adebola fights to bring it back. When Princess Amari steals a magical scroll that can reactivate magic, Zélie, her brother Tzain, and the princess form an unlikely alliance to complete a dangerous ritual. Together, they must outrun Prince Inan and royal forces intent on destroying magic forever. Through shared sacrifice and newfound courage, they spark a rebellion that could reshape their world.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the vibrant land of Orïsha, magic once flourished through ten distinct guilds of maji, but everything changed during the Raid, a night of ruthless slaughter ordered by King Saran. Years later, Zélie Adebola lives as an oppressed diviner, harboring deep grief for her mother who was murdered in the purges. Her life drastically shifts when she encounters Princess Amari, who is fleeing the palace after witnessing the King murder her best friend to suppress a magic-awakening scroll. Zélie and her brother Tzain join forces with Amari to complete a sacred ritual requiring three ancient artifacts: the scroll, a sunstone, and a bone dagger. As the trio embarks on a perilous journey across Orïsha to reach the sacred temple before a rare solstice, they are relentlessly pursued by Prince Inan. Inan is fiercely loyal to his father's mission to eradicate magic, yet he struggles with a secret of his own—the sudden manifestation of his own forbidden maji abilities. Tensions rise as Inan's path intersects with Zélie's, leading to a complex dynamic between hatred, understanding, and shared destinies. Along the way, the rebels rally fellow diviners, face deadly arenas, and contend with the heavy cost of freedom. Ultimately, their desperate quest leads to a explosive confrontation that determines whether magic will rise again or be permanently erased.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in the rich, West African-inspired realm of Orïsha, *Children of Blood and Bone* chronicles a high-stakes struggle for liberation, identity, and justice. Following a traumatic genocide known as the Raid, the ruling monarchy stripped the land of its magic, leaving the diviners—those capable of becoming maji—vulnerable, impoverished, and heavily persecuted under King Saran's iron rule. The narrative follows Zélie Adebola, a fierce young woman determined to reclaim her heritage, alongside her protective brother Tzain and the fugitive royal Princess Amari. Driven by hope and a dangerous quest to revive Orïsha's lost powers before an impending celestial event, the group navigates treacherous landscapes, hostile forces, and moral dilemmas. This story delivers a captivating, emotionally charged fantasy adventure exploring themes of systemic oppression, grief, family, and the enduring strength required to defy tyranny.

story_structure.climax: At the sacred temple during the centennial solstice, Zélie attempts the final ritual while facing off against King Saran and his forces in a desperate struggle for the future of magic.
story_structure.conflict: When Princess Amari escapes the royal palace with a sacred artifact that can reawaken magic, she allies with Zélie and her brother Tzain, sparking a high-stakes quest to save her people.
story_structure.resolution: The dramatic aftermath of the ritual permanently reshapes Orïsha's power structure, leaving the surviving characters to face profound personal losses and an uncertain new reality.
story_structure.introduction: In the oppressed realm of Orïsha, Zélie, a young woman whose community lost its magic during a violent monarchy-led purge, struggles under the brutal regime of King Saran.
story_structure.risingAction: Hunted across Orïsha by Prince Inan and royal troops, the trio navigates dangerous lands to gather the three sacred relics required to perform an ancient magic-restoration ritual before the upcoming solstice.
